question:

 **Group - I**
 **Group - II**
 
 

 I.
 solid waste
 A.
 Composting
 
 

 II.
 organic waste
 B.
 open dumping
 
 

 III.
 Hospital Waste
 C.
 Incineration

options.text: I – B, II – C, III – A
I – C, II – A, III – B
I – C, II – B, III – A
I – B, II – A, III – C

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4: I – B, II – A, III – C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Solid Waste and Open Dumping: **Solid waste, often comprising a mix of various kinds of wastes including both decomposable and non-decomposable materials, is frequently managed through open dumping, especially in less regulated areas.
 
• **Organic Waste and Composting: **Organic waste, which includes food scraps, yard waste, and other biodegradable materials, is ideally suited for composting. Composting is a process that accelerates the natural decay of organic material and transforms it into a valuable fertilizer for soil enrichment.
 
• **Hospital Waste and Incineration:** Hospital waste, which includes biohazardous materials and items that are potentially infectious or contaminated, is best disposed of through incineration. This method effectively destroys bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Open Dumping:** This is the least environmentally friendly method of waste disposal, leading to various problems such as air and water pollution, and impacting wildlife and human health.
 
• **Composting: **This eco-friendly approach not only recycles organic waste but also reduces greenhouse gas emissions as compared to landfilling and incineration, by avoiding methane production.
 
• **Incineration: **While effective in reducing the volume of waste and destroying hazardous substances, it can lead to the emission of toxic gases if not properly managed, necessitating advanced pollution control technologies.
 
• **Solid Waste Management: **Involves various strategies including recycling, biological treatment, thermal treatment, and disposal, with the choice of strategy depending on the nature of the waste and local environmental regulations.
